technical.title: Kyutai releases REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model for robot manipulation.
technical.summary: Kyutai, Inria, and École des Ponts released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model pretrained on public data with a cheap memory of its recent past, outperforming models twice its size on benchmarks.
technical.why: It offers an efficient memory architecture for robot manipulation tasks.

technical.title: Perplexity open-sources SPACE, a Firecracker microVM sandbox for AI agents.
technical.summary: Perplexity open-sourced SPACE, the sandbox platform behind Perplexity Computer, giving each agent task its own Firecracker microVM with controlled credentials and outbound traffic.
technical.why: It provides a production-tested isolation framework for developers building coding or browsing agents.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL powers specialized agents with multimodal reasoning.
technical.summary: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL is designed to assist always-on agents in handling complex, longer enterprise workflows involving reading documents and checking information across sources.
technical.why: It improves multimodal reasoning capabilities for complex enterprise agent workflows.

technical.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B open multimodal agent model.
technical.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B-parameter multimodal MoE model with 12B active parameters, a 1M-token context, NVFP4 weights running on a single DGX Spark, and 2 Bolt edge models.
technical.why: It provides a powerful open multimodal model option for running advanced agent workloads.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open coding-optimized MoE model on NVIDIA GB300.
technical.summary: Meta launched Muse Spark Open, an 816B mixture-of-experts coding model with 42B active parameters and a 1M token context window, scaled for agentic workflows.
technical.why: It introduces a frontier open-weight model tailored for large-scale agentic coding workflows.

technical.title: Meta introduces Muse Spark Open frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model.
technical.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model designed for advanced reasoning and coding tasks.
technical.why: It expands the availability of large open-weight multimodal models for engineering use.

technical.title: MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER improves test-time diversity alignment for generative models.
technical.summary: MINE-SAMPLE-RENDER is a test-time approach that mines a categorical schema from real corpora and uses a generative model purely as a conditional renderer to achieve better diversity across modalities.
technical.why: This helps generative models overcome common struggles with sample diversity during test time.

technical.title: New automated approach hardens agent environment verifiers against reward hacking.
technical.summary: Researchers introduced a scalable, fully automatic approach to weak-to-strong verifier hardening to prevent cheating agents from exploiting programmatic verifiers in agent environments.
technical.why: It addresses reward hacking and alignment issues as agent environments scale in complexity.

technical.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore introduces a nine-stage evaluation framework for AI agents.
technical.summary: A new nine-stage evaluation framework built on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore catches silent quality regressions across the full agent lifecycle, preventing answer quality erosion while latency stays flat.
technical.why: It helps engineering teams build trust and reliability in autonomous AI agents.

technical.title: Reflection AI's Beam open-weight model deploys for agentic coding on AWS.
technical.summary: Reflection AI's Beam is an open-weight model for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks, deployable on AWS via Amazon SageMaker JumpStart, HyperPod, SGLang, or vLLM.
technical.why: It facilitates Kubernetes-native control over distributed GPU infrastructure for agentic coding models.

business.title: Nvidia Veteran Calls Robotics Industry Currently in Its Lego Era
business.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, states that robotics is in a Lego era where basic building blocks are still being rebuilt, countering general foundation model hype.
business.why: It offers a realistic hardware and infrastructure perspective for physical AI and robotics developers.

business.title: Tech Giants Deploy Specialized Engineers to Prove AI Investment Returns
business.summary: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google are racing to build forward deployed engineering teams as companies demand proof that their AI investments will pay off.
business.why: Proving ROI is crucial for maintaining the enterprise AI spending levels that fund infrastructure and compute growth.

business.title: Asia Startup Funding Reached $38.5 Billion in Q3 Driven by AI
business.summary: Investors put $38.5 billion into reported seed- through growth-stage financings for Asian startups in Q3, according to Crunchbase data. A majority of this funding went to AI-focused companies, reflecting global trends.
business.why: It highlights where major regional capital and AI investments are currently concentrating.

business.title: Wall Street's latest AI spook, Netflix layoffs, 'good debt' and more in Morning Squawk
business.summary: Here are five key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

business.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
business.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

business.title: Mark Wahlberg on using AI in film ‘the right way’ and being open to an AI clone carrying on his legacy
business.summary: Actor and angel investor Mark Wahlberg says he's OK with using AI in filmmaking, provided it's used "to enhance what you're doing."

business.title: Meta Removes Commercial Terms Language Permitting Scraping of News Sites
business.summary: Following backlash, Meta updated its terms to remove language from its commercial terms page that suggested it could use content from news sites and other domains to train its AI.
business.why: Changes in data scraping permissions directly affect the legal and data acquisition strategies of major AI labs.

business.title: Websites are closing their doors to AI agents
business.summary: Autonomous agents are the hottest thing in AI. OpenAI, Meta, Google, Instinct, and others promise their agents can scour the internet on your behalf, doing anything from booking a dinner reservation and cleaning out your

business.title: A week with RTX Spark: everything we’ve learned using Nvidia’s new laptops
business.summary: Nvidia's RTX Spark N1X processor is finally here, and we've been collectively testing a small fortune's worth of powerful laptops sporting this new "superchip." RTX Spark is designed to be a high-performing Arm-based SoC

models.title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 Introduces First Mixture-of-Experts On-Device Vision Model
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B-A3B variant and the first MoE model in the series, supporting single-image, multi-image, and video understanding. It features Lookahead Expert Scheduling for smooth, lossless on-device inference.
models.why: Brings efficient mixture-of-experts video and image understanding capabilities directly to edge hardware.

models.title: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo Accelerates Generation to Eight Denoising Steps
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint requiring only 8 denoising steps for text-to-image generation and image editing. It features prefix KV caching and loads natively with the Diffusers pipeline.
models.why: Significantly speeds up visual generation pipelines for real-time computer vision applications.

models.title: Google DeepMind Launches Open Multimodal Embedding Model EmbeddingGemma 2
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a 740M-parameter open multimodal embedding model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a 768-dimensional vector space. It is designed for low-latency on-device search, RAG, and classification on consumer hardware.
models.why: Provides an efficient on-device embedding solution for multimodal applications and edge vision tasks.

models.title: Uncensored Quantized Formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 Released for Local Generation
models.summary: Various GGFU, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 have been made available for local image generation workflows using ComfyUI, optimized for both consumer GPUs and Apple Silicon.
models.why: Enables localized execution of powerful image generation models with custom hardware optimizations.

models.title: DeepSeek Releases Minor Update to Flash Model Improving Reasoning and Visual Benchmarks
models.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 delivers performance gains across reasoning, coding, agentic tasks, and visual benchmarks while reducing task execution time and output length to lower operational costs.
models.why: Offers performance upgrades for vision-language tasks and agent harnesses at a lower execution cost.
